cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 89 since November 9, 2022. Works as an executive; his listed career includes director of government relations at Troy University. Lost the 2018 Republican primary for the same seat, then won it in 2022.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Marcus Paramore was born or raised, or when he moved to Alabama. We found no statements from him on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, guns, abortion, policing or schools, and no campaign platform. We found no bills he sponsored that we could read, because the sponsored-legislation table on his page was empty. We found no endorsements, controversies or foreign ties. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys in 2022 or 2026. We also could not confirm details of his Troy University job, such as dates or title, beyond the single line on his Ballotpedia page.
